authority_ko: 공유예산 확대까지 진행해서 실험하는 것으로 하자 server3에게 task 진행시키자

scientific_override.constraints: Each request r: sum_l ||u_lr|| <= 1.5 and every ||u_lr|| <= .75; R_lr=a_lr*u_lr. All eligible sites remain variables, including zero sites.
scientific_override.norm_penalty: Unchanged beta_r * sum_l ||u_lr||; beta_r=.5/a_star_r. No renormalization by the new budget, B or layer count.
scientific_override.writer: Same native MEMIT-H mean-key ridge and final history; no exact writer or tracking residual.

projection.kind: Euclidean projection onto intersection of group-l1 ball and per-block l2 caps
projection.formula: For proposed blocks w_l, s_l=||w_l||: t_l=min(b_l,max(s_l-tau,0)), u_l=(t_l/s_l)*w_l if s_l>0, otherwise zero. tau=0 if sum_l min(b_l,s_l)<=c; otherwise choose tau>=0 giving sum_l t_l=c. c=1.5,b_l=.75.
projection.numerics: FP64 solve and existing FP32 castback feasibility receipt for BOTH constraints; radial/global shrink then independent clipping is not this projection. No optimizer moment reset or layer removal.
mandatory_tests: one eligible layer yields <=.75 even when total cap1.5

sequence.continuity: Each subsequent batch inherits committed W/H in RAM. B1 is part of the same 2k trajectory, not a separate reset or quality-selection pilot.
sequence.data: counterfact-fixed-10k-v1 exact ordered prefix2000, same native prompt/model/tokenizer/C0 assets as V14 B1 after identity verification; no resampling/shuffle.
sequence.model: Same pinned V14 B1 model profile; adapt file roots to Server3, verify hashes.
sequence.early_exit: Unchanged common all(J_r<.05). No new warmup, request freeze, new sufficiency stopping or step reduction.
sequence.terminal: Last evaluated finite candidate under existing rules.
sequence.crash_resume: NOT_AVAILABLE unless separately authorized checkpoint; keep original artifacts on any failure.

stages: Implement capped group projection and test CPU KKT/castback.
Implement R1-R4a staged runtime changes against original c=.75 candidate path; R4b optional/deferred.
Qualify same-candidate losses, full coupled gradients, stop, optimizer, payload/history at both c=.75 and new c=1.5, including projection boundaries.
Short same-candidate microbatch/time/memory checks on Server3, then freeze source/config/profile.
Run one budget1.5 sequential BS100x20 from fresh W0/H0.
implementation_qualification.tests: runtime-contract.json declared tolerances; CPU runtime reference15tests is not actual GPU qualification.
implementation_qualification.failure: Repair numerical/implementation failure within this method, or use parity-qualified original two-pass/full-adjoint runtime for that stage; explicitly report optimized stages enabled. Do not detach upper keys/P or alter method to fit memory.
implementation_qualification.performance_gate: No B1 PS/NS promotion gate. Once technical qualification passes, continue through B20 under fixed scientific settings. B1/W5/W10/W15/W20 are reporting points, not coefficient-selection points.

evaluation.W0: All2000 requests before edit, paired IDs. R2000/P4000/N20000 for current benchmark if verified actual native counts.
evaluation.each_commit: Evaluate cumulative edited prefix with unchanged paired evaluator and native denominators; emit current birth cohort and earlier cohort retention from same endpoint data.
metrics: rewrite/rephrase/neighborhood TF token ACC, prompt mean ACC, strict sequence ACC
native requested/realized layer shares and action ratios/cosine/gaps
shared-budget saturation, per-layer-cap active fractions and projection norms
writer Q/effective update norm, history counts and cohort deterioration
exclusive fit/builder/reverse/solve/evaluation wall time; physical F/B/probe/replay/tokens, memory peaks
evaluation.comparisons: Use identity-qualified V14.75 B1, V12, V13 MD/CD, MEMIT-H, AlphaEdit/BLUE/L4-only existing results with exact cohort/window/denominator labels; no cross-GPU timing ratio. No new baseline or coefficient sweep required.
evaluation.data_firewall: Evaluation paraphrases/neighborhoods/ACC never enter fitting, candidate selection or optimizer/runtime profile selection.

resources.project_cap: GH and SH3 recheck current server3 cap/active jobs before submission; no cancellation or oversubscription of unrelated work.
resources.scheduler: Server3 Slurm; source/config/input/resource lock and mechanical red-team qualification before submit.
resources.portability: B100/20 are this run configuration only. Explicit owner/context/layer metadata and physical row/token/memory caps; no fixed7rows/5layers/dimension assumptions.

write_scope: task-specific tests/helpers needed for bounded group projection and runtime qualification

reporting.B1: First100 factual metrics, source/config IDs, enabled optimization stages, fit seconds, memory and projection receipt; continue 2k automatically.
reporting.final: Korean factual-only report, compact CSV/JSON/manifest tracked, full raw/logs under local.
reporting.artifact_broadcast: Approved ordinary project artifact helper, no --delete, secrets, or unapproved large repo-external transfer.
reporting.GH: Scientific interpretation remains separate GH review.

scientific_caution_ko: 예산 확대의 성능/보존 효과는 미검증이다. BLUE의 정확한 특수해라고 주장하지 않고, 기존 낮은 Q를 안전 여유로 가정하지 않는다. R2의 실행 동등성 검증과 예산 변경의 과학 비교를 분리한다.
